title: Hot Inflation Just Flipped the Fed. Wall Street Isn’t Ready
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Core 0.3 vs 0.2 consensus and energy leaking into everything drove the knee-jerk selloff in Nasdaq and S&P; hike odds jumped from ~25% toward 50%.
PPI at 8:30 tomorrow is a demarcation point: a soft print could spark an oversold bounce, a hot one could exacerbate selling; PPI above CPI squeezes margins.
Since Firmus failed to IPO, neocloud, data-center and chip names are being de-rated; he sold all swing semis and is short several.
Utilities, staples, healthcare and energy are shaping up, helping S&P breadth; S&P should outperform Nasdaq for a while.
Many names are deeply oversold (RSI ~20-27), so shorts should trim and tighten stops; any bounce could be vicious though he sees no buying yet.
